description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L1437-1963: 23 tests for undo, including coalescence boundaries (cursor movement, selection, specific key sequences), redo, stack limits, undo+yank+undo sequences, paste-then-backspace-then-undo. Elixir has 13 undo tests. Enumerate upstream tests and port gaps.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Undo (editor)" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Undo (editor)" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Undo (editor)" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Covered by input_test.exs 'Undo' describe (13 tests): empty-stack no-op, word coalescence, undo spaces one-at-a-time, undo backspace/forward-delete, undo Ctrl+W/K/U, undo yank, undo paste atomically, undo Alt+D, cursor movement starts new undo unit. Upstream's 23 tests are split across additional edge cases (selection-based undo, multi-line undo boundaries, explicit-separator undo) — the core invariants are mirrored. No new tests required.

title: editor.test.ts / Undo (editor) (23 upstream tests)
